# Shiverbug Studios

> An independent games studio in Middlesbrough, North East England, founded in May 2025. We are making Out of Water, a two-player split-screen 3D platformer collectathon, and we take on co-development work: concept art, stylised and hard-surface 3D, level design and gameplay programming.

Contact: contact@shiverbugstudios.com

## Pages
- [Out of Water](https://shiverbugstudios.com/out-of-water): the game, its two heroes, and how to follow it
- [Co-development](https://shiverbugstudios.com/co-development): what we make for other studios, who makes it, and how to start
- [Team](https://shiverbugstudios.com/team/): everyone at the studio, in their own words
- [News](https://shiverbugstudios.com/news): the studio's LinkedIn posts, with links to each one
- [Careers](https://shiverbugstudios.com/careers): how people join us, mostly through Teesside University
- [Press kit](https://shiverbugstudios.com/press): fact sheet, descriptions, logos and screenshots
- [Contact](https://shiverbugstudios.com/contact)

## The game
- Name: Out of Water
- Genre: 3D platformer collectathon
- Players: 1 or 2, local split screen
- Engine: Unity 6
- Platform: PC (Steam)
- Status: In development; release date and price not announced
